layout.arrangement: Title centered at top in red. Slide number '29' in a yellow circle at top-right. Below title: a row of four data-point vectors X1..X4 with y-values beneath, plus a 'Predict' vector X=(7,3) with y=???. To the right of that row, two boxed formulas: W = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T Y (red box) and y = W^T X (blue box). Second row: 'Augmented Vectors' panel showing the same vectors with a leading 1 row, y-values below. Bottom area: four matrix panels left-to-right: y column vector, X matrix, X^T matrix, X^T X matrix (with a callout note 'Always Symmetric (and its inverse)' pointing to it). Bottom-left: (X^T X)^{-1} matrix. Bottom-right green panel: W computation and final equation y = 3x_1 + 2x_2 + 5.

Yellow circle badge top-right with '29'. 4. Upper-left panel: labels 'x_1 =>' and 'x_2 =>' at left; four column vectors X_1=(1;1), X_2=(2;2), X_3=(2;1), X_4=(1;2) in blue with parentheses; red y-values y_1=10, y_2=15, y_3=13, y_4=12 beneath each; then green italic 'Predict' with X=(7;3) and red 'y = ? ? ?'. 5. Middle panel: rows labeled '1 =>', 'x_1 =>', 'x_2 =>'; augmented vectors X_1=(1;1;1), X_2=(1;2;2), X_3=(1;2;1), X_4=(1;1;2); red y-values below; magenta italic 'Augmented Vectors' at right. 7. Bottom-right green (#CCFFCC) panel: 'W = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T Y => W = (5;3;2)' with 5 red, 3 green, 2 blue; below on pale yellow highlight: 'y = 3 x_1 + 2 x_2 + 5' in red.
